svg.title: How Gram works
svg.desc: You give the orchestrator goals, answers and approvals. Inside the workspace the orchestrator keeps a memory of goals, decisions and rulings, sends briefs to workers and gets reports and questions back. Each worker runs Claude or Codex in its own worktree, and workers talk to each other. Workers open pull requests, which go through checks, merge and release. CI, review and merge events wake the worker that owns the pull request, and the orchestrator gets a digest.
